title: Scratch (DJ)
description: Moves the sound like a record under the hand of a DJ: per step the record is pushed forward and pulled back, pulled back only, spun back or cut, so the sound squeals up and down in pitch.

inputs.name: region
inputs.title: Region in
inputs.description: A region (the joins of a loop) to process instead of audio. The result stays a region: it never reaches an audio input, only a region-merge block turns it back into audio.

outputs.name: region
outputs.title: Loop seam
outputs.description: The processed region. Connect it to another effect or to a region-merge block.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.doc: Off passes the sound through untouched (bypass).

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.doc: Steps of a bar, bars separated by |: 16 a bar, or 12, 24 or 32 for triplet and finer grids. x is a baby scratch (forward and back), b pulls the record back only, f pushes it forward only, c is a chirp (forward and back with the fader closed at the turn), r spins it back like a rewind, - cuts the sound and . leaves it as it is. Bar n of the song uses bar ((n - 1) mod count) of the pattern.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.doc: How far the record is moved in one scratch, in milliseconds of sound: more is a bigger, higher squeal.

parameters.name: bars
parameters.doc: The song bars where the pattern plays, separated by commas (empty: every bar); the other bars pass untouched.

parameters.name: mix
parameters.doc: How much of the scratched sound replaces the plain sound in the scratched steps.

parameters.name: channels
parameters.doc: auto: stereo when an input or the source is stereo, otherwise mono; mono: sum to mono; stereo: always two channels (a mono sound is copied to both).
